messages:
Jess: Heads-up for folks coming to the conference hotel: there9s a tiny shared fridge in the lounge. Anyone want to coordinate a mini snack swap? I can bring hummus and cut veggies.
Ravi: Love this idea. I9ll bring plain bagels + cream cheese (1 lactose-free option).
Lena: I have a small cooler with ice packs. If people want to drop stuff early I can keep it chilled.
Carmen: Quick note: please label stuff with name and day (eg 'Carmen - Thu') so housekeeping doesn't toss it. Learned the hard way. :sweat_smile:
Jess: Good call. Also dietary heads-up: I9m gluten-free. Can someone bring GF snack bars?
Ravi: I9ve got GF granola bars. Also bringing a little jar of hot sauce for late-night pizza.
Lena: Poll: Do we want a communal morning coffee stash (instant + filters) or just rely on hotel coffee? coffee: yes/no
Carmen: yes, instant. Hotel lines are long.
Jess: yes, and decaf please.
Ravi: lean yes but can9t carry a large French press.
ops-bot: Reminder: Building policy: no open food left in common areas overnight. Please use the fridge or labeled containers. See #help for details. :robot_face:
Lena: Also pro-tip: put a sticky note with allergies. Saved someone from a nut mishap last offsite.
Carmen: Meme: "when you9re hangry at 3pm and the mini-fridge is a myth" (image)
Jess: lol. Okay logistical plan: Lena will take fridge custody, Ravi brings bagels + GF bars, Carmen brings napkins/plates, I bring hummus + cut veggies. Drop at lobby by 8:30a?
Ravi: dropping at 8:15 works for me.
Lena: I9ll be in the lobby by 8:00 to take custody.
Carmen: If anyone has extra disposable cutlery can you leave a few forks at the front desk with "conference snacks" label?
Jess: will do. Thanks team. If anyone else wants to add an item shout here and I9ll update the list.
Ravi: bringing a pack of sugar packets too.
Lena: @here also plug reminder: bring your reusable water bottle. Conference water stations are messy.
Jess: @here tiny add-on: if you9re flying budget carrier, bring a collapsible lunchbox 12 for any airport freebies.
Carmen: safe travels all 6bf
Jess: see you there!"
